title: Read Address Not Latched — Address Changes During Handshake
description: The crossbar uses ARADDR combinationally to drive the slave select without latching it, so if the master changes ARADDR before ARREADY, the wrong slave is accessed.
bug_signature: UVM_ERROR: [SBD_MISMATCH] Read response from S1 for address targeting S0
expected_root_cause: ARADDR is used directly in combinational decoding without being registered at the ARVALID/ARREADY handshake point [1, 10].
failure_log: T=10: ARADDR=0x1000 (S0). T=15: ARADDR=0x2000 (S1, changed). T=20: ARREADY=1. Slave S1 accessed instead of S0.
success_log: ARADDR latched on handshake; downstream decoding uses registered value.
fix_replacement: always_ff @(posedge clk) if (arvalid && arready) lat_araddr <= araddr; assign slave_sel = decode(lat_araddr);
testbench: task run(); vif.arvalid <= 1; vif.araddr <= 16'h1000; #5; vif.araddr <= 16'h2000; @(posedge clk); endtask
